about.en: MongoDB bStock (MDBB) is a tokenized share of MongoDB, Inc. issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain, backed 1:1 by MDB shares held with a regulated custodian and convertible 1:1 into the underlying equity, and it passes through the price movements and corporate-action adjustments of that share. bStocks are admitted to trading under prospectuses approved by the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority and are not offered in every jurisdiction.
